headline: Rheinmetall Opens Telford Factory to Restore UK Tank Barrel Manufacturing
summary: German defense contractor Rheinmetall opened a manufacturing facility in Telford, restoring domestic tank barrel production in the United Kingdom after a 20-year reliance on foreign military suppliers.
why: Rheinmetall is one of Europe's largest munitions and military vehicle manufacturers. Expanding onshore defense manufacturing capacity addresses procurement bottlenecks amid rising NATO defense spending.

impacts.name: Rheinmetall AG
impacts.why: Securing local UK manufacturing footprints positions the company for multi-year British defense procurement orders.
